title.es: Aquel en el que Marta elige a Fina
title.en: The One Where Marta Chooses Fina

description.es: Marta y Cloe conversan sobre lo sucedido el día anterior. Marta deja claro que su prioridad es encontrar a Fina y que, aunque su relación con Cloe no pudo continuar, la considera alguien importante a quien no quiere herir más. Además, le comparte sus avances en la búsqueda y menciona que ha contactado con asociaciones de fotógrafos donde Fina podría estar registrada, esperando que alguna de ellas le den alguna pista.
description.en: Marta and Cloe talk about what happened the day before. Marta makes it clear that her priority is to find Fina and that, although her relationship with Cloe couldn't continue, she considers her someone important whom she doesn't want to hurt any further. She also shares her progress in the search and mentions that she has contacted photographers' associations where Fina might be registered, hoping one of them will give her a lead.
